description: This file contains the implementation of the Login class within the Opencart administrative startup controllers, responsible for managing login-related actions, sessions, and route handling for the admin panel.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Handles the login process, user session setup, and route validation within the admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Determines the current route, checks if the user is logged in, and redirects to the login page if necessary. Manages session tokens and ignores specific routes.
